job.question: In the American Academy of Actuaries' 2011 RFP for retirement plan and related consulting services, what were the plan assets at 12/31/10 of each of its three retirement plans?
job.expected_facts: Money Purchase plan: $3,015,682; 401(k) plan: $1,993,513; Defined Benefit plan: $647,181 (all as of 12/31/10).
job.acceptance: Accept amounts mapped correctly to Money Purchase, 401(k), and Defined Benefit; profit-sharing description is optional.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2024 Teachers’ Retirement System of Illinois RFP for private equity investment consulting, not the American Academy of Actuaries’ 2011 RFP. It provides no 12/31/10 asset amounts for the three specified plans.
quotes: Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR PRIVATE EQUITY INVESTMENT CONSULTANT SERVICES Issued August 7, 2024
The System serves over 448,000 members and had over $70 billion in assets held in trust for its membership as of March 31, 2024.
